description: Six-track stem player: each track plays a loaded audio file out of its own jack, and one transport runs all six together

params.text: Sets the playback level of that track
Switches that track on or off
Stops playback of all six tracks
Starts playback of all six tracks from the beginning of the files
Starts playback of all six tracks
Pauses playback of all six tracks
Moves all six tracks back to the start of the files
Makes playback return to the start of the files when the end is reached

inputs.text: A trigger here starts playback from the beginning of the files
A trigger here moves all six tracks back to the start

notes: every track is empty when the module is placed and its output rests at 0V, so a file has to be loaded from the right-click menu before the transport plays anything
each of the six tracks has a row of its own in the right-click menu, carrying the name of the file loaded in it in square brackets; clicking that row opens a file chooser for that track alone
a track's meter is green when the file matches the engine sample rate, orange when the file was upsampled to reach it, and red when it was downsampled and high frequencies were thrown away
menu: Load Files from Folder — reads the first six audio files of a folder into the six tracks at once, in WAV or FLAC
Smooth Start-Stop — fades the tracks in and out at a start and a stop instead of cutting them, which takes the click off the transport
